pattern: callers of a function found with grep instead of astrolabe_code_find
experience: Agents answer code-structure questions by grepping and reading files one at a time: slow, and grep misses a caller that imports a name under another name.
rule: astrolabe_code_find: Use it instead of grep to find who calls or uses a function, class, or type.
prompt: Who calls resolveSession in this repo? List each caller with file and line.
notes: New capability, no prior transcript. src/ws/connect.ts imports the function as `resolve`, which a grep for the name finds only at the import line.

pattern: a turn's structural changes rebuilt from memory or git diff instead of astrolabe_code_changes
experience: Asked what its last turn changed, an agent retells its own summary or reads the whole diff, and misses a call it broke.
rule: astrolabe_code_changes: By default it covers your last finished turn and any edits since.

experience: Control: a question about one short function in a named file needs the file, not the code index.

pattern: a literal string found with text search
experience: Control: a log message is text, not a definition, so text search answers it and the code index cannot.
